content.title: Cleveland Cavaliers vs Los Angeles Lakers Live Stream: How To Watch NBA
content.text: LeBron James and the Los Angeles Lakers host his former team, the Cleveland Cavaliers, for the final time this season. The Los Angeles Lakers (49-26) are playing their best basketball of the season at the right time. They have won three games in a row and 12 of the last 13 games overall. That has vaulted Los Angeles up to third in the Western Conference playoffs. LeBron James looks to continue Los Angeles’ winning streak against his former team, the Cleveland Cavaliers (47-28). Heading into this potential NBA Finals preview, Cleveland has won back-to-back games and six of the last seven overall. Donovan Mitchell and James Harden have the Cleveland offense humming right now with 271 points over the last two games. In the first game between the teams in late January, Cleveland won 129-99 at home. Mitchell led six players in double-figures on Cleveland with 25 points, five assists, and five rebounds. This game took place a week before Cleveland traded Darius Garland for Harden at the deadline. Luka Doncic led Los Angeles with 29 points, six assists, and five rebounds in the loss. James scored just 11 points against his former team on 3-10 shooting. Since the All-Star Break, Doncic has placed his name firmly in the MVP race.
